data.continuity_rule: only contiguous windows used; no gaps bridged or fabricated

methodology.date_ranges_preserved: Same 20 period ranges and sampling seeds as the previous zero-cost 20-period experiment.
methodology.position_management: One trade at a time per period; no overlapping positions; position is closed at the breakout exit horizon.
methodology.risk_model: Zero-cost spot research only; no fees, spread, slippage, or live execution assumptions.
methodology.selection_rule: Frozen strategy parameters were fixed before running this experiment; no optimization against these periods.
